description: Survivors of domestic violence, stalking, sexual assault, and others with civil protections orders against their abuser will have a little less to worry about once a new Hope Card program takes effect.“Survivors have enough to worry about,” said Rep. Dan Griffey, R-Allyn, the prime sponsor of the bill. “Already, so many advantages go to the abuser. This is one advantage we can give to the survivors. It's a passport to their life. It's a passport to hope.”House Bill 1766 will create the Hope Card
paid_for_by: Paid for by Griffey For State House bottom of page
title: Griffey's Hope Card Bill Signed By Governor
